# Just Organized by Taya

> Professional home organizing and decluttering services in Houston, TX specializing in system setup, moving transitions, and space management.

Just Organized by Taya is a professional organizing service based in Houston that helps homeowners declutter, organize, and set up systems for kitchens, closets, playrooms, and entire homes. The service also specializes in moving preparation and transition support.

## Key Topics

- Home organization
- Decluttering services
- System setup
- Kitchen organization
- Closet organization
- Playroom organization
- Moving and transition
- Professional organizer
- Space management
- Sentimental items
- Virtual organizing
- Space design
- Pre-move organizing
- Houston, TX

## Core Services

- [Home Organizing and System Set Up](https://justorganized.org/home-organizing-and-system-set-up): Home organizing and system setup services by Taya covering kitchens, closets, playrooms.
- [Decluttering](https://justorganized.org/decluttering): Professional decluttering services handling sentimental items and pre-move organizing.
- [Moving and Transition](https://justorganized.org/moving-and-transition): Moving and transition services including unpacking and new home setup by Taya.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Houston Home Organization Portfolio](https://justorganized.org/houston-home-organization-portfolio): Portfolio showcasing Houston home organization projects and before-after case studies.
